message: We turn your ideas into motion.
narrativeArc: A single spark of an idea grows into a word, the word settles into a living shape, the camera draws us into that world, a line traces the idea in motion, and it all resolves into the studio's name and a warm invitation.
visualThesis: One spark is the spine of the whole film; every beat is the same idea, seen a little further along as it comes to life.
copyStrategy: Short, plain, human lines that hand off from one to the next like a single sentence spoken slowly.

beatIntentions.message: Every great thing starts as one small idea.

beatIntentions.objective: Reveal the idea lives in a world.
beatIntentions.message: We give it room to grow.

adjacentIntentionPairs.cameraRationale: Hold; the spark grows in place into the word.
Ease back so the word settles into a wider world.
Push gently in as a line begins to trace through the world.
Hold; the line's end resolves into the studio mark on the same motion.
Hold; the name settles and the invitation rises beneath it.
